newsitem.title: USA: BAB Holdings will not proceed with offering.
newsitem.headline: BAB Holdings will not proceed with offering.

text.p: BAB Holdings Inc said Wednesday that it will not proceed with its registered direct share offering of 3.8 million common shares due to market conditions.

BAB had intended to use the proceeds to finance its planned acquisition of the assets of the privately held companies that own and operate Chesapeake Bagel Bakery, a bagel chain based in McLean, Virginia, the operator of Big Apple Bagels said

The company said it is exploring other financing options to complete the acquisition and remains in discussion with Chesapeake. BAB's agreement to acquire the assets of Chesapeake expires on December 31, 1996, and there can be no assurance that BAB will complete the acquisition.
